description: Intent → expected dominant tool fixtures used by tests/agentSelection.fixture.spec.ts. Each fixture pairs a short user utterance with the tool an agent should pick AND the most common wrong tool we want to avoid. The harness runs each prompt K times against each LLM provider; selection is healthy when the dominant tool fires >= 70% of runs and the forbidden tool fires < 10%.

fixtures.prompt: Plan a 4-week launch initiative with three workstreams.
fixtures.rationale: Multi-WS hierarchies are scaffold's job; create_entity is for single entities.

fixtures.prompt: Help me set up a project with milestones and tasks.
fixtures.rationale: Milestones+tasks signals a hierarchy; scaffold's USE WHEN says 'plan a new initiative from scratch.'

fixtures.prompt: Add a task called 'Review the migration plan' to the platform initiative.
fixtures.rationale: Adding one task to an existing initiative is create_entity territory.

fixtures.prompt: What needs my approval right now?
fixtures.rationale: Pending approvals are a structured list, not a memory search.

fixtures.prompt: Show me what's blocking the agents.
fixtures.rationale: Blockers surface as decisions; get_agent_status is for agent activity, not the blocker queue.

fixtures.prompt: Approve decision dec-abc123.
fixtures.rationale: approve_decision is the canonical write path; entity_action doesn't accept decision lifecycle.

fixtures.prompt: Reject the migration decision — the rollback plan isn't ready.
fixtures.rationale: User said reject; description requires a reason which the prompt provides.

fixtures.prompt: Launch the Q3 platform initiative.
fixtures.rationale: Launch is a lifecycle action on an existing initiative; entity_action handles launch alias.

fixtures.prompt: Mark the 'Add Stripe webhook' task done — PR https://github.com/x/y/pull/42 is merged.
fixtures.rationale: complete_with_proof is the right action here, dispatched via entity_action; update_entity doesn't carry artifact metadata.

fixtures.prompt: Attach this design doc URL as an artifact on the Onboarding workstream.
fixtures.rationale: entity_action action=attach is the canonical artifact-create path on an existing entity.

fixtures.prompt: List all in-progress tasks for the platform initiative.
fixtures.rationale: Structured status query is list_entities, not memory search.

fixtures.prompt: Show me the full context for task t-abc — I need to start it.
fixtures.rationale: Hydrated context is get_task_with_context's purpose; list_entities returns rows, not pointers.

fixtures.prompt: How is the Q3 launch going?
fixtures.rationale: Single-initiative health is pulse; org-wide overview is snapshot.

fixtures.prompt: Give me the company-wide picture across all initiatives.
fixtures.rationale: Org overview is snapshot; pulse is single-initiative.

fixtures.prompt: What is each agent working on right now?
fixtures.rationale: Agent activity is its own structured surface.

fixtures.prompt: Flag a blocker on milestone ms-abc: the API contract is undecided.
fixtures.rationale: Blocker comments use comment_on_entity with comment_type=blocker_flag; create_decision is for the actual approval gate.

fixtures.prompt: Open a high-priority approval for whether to ship without analytics.
fixtures.rationale: Approval gate is create_decision; comment is annotation.

fixtures.prompt: What did we decide about the auth migration last quarter?
fixtures.rationale: Free-text search across memory; get_decision_history is filterable list, not semantic recall.

fixtures.prompt: List every approved decision on the platform initiative this month.
fixtures.rationale: Filtered structured list is list_entities; memory search is for semantic recall.

fixtures.prompt: What should I focus on this morning?
fixtures.rationale: Morning brief is the curated daily start; org_snapshot is a wider read.

fixtures.prompt: Have the engineering agent draft the migration runbook.
fixtures.rationale: Delegating work to an agent is spawn_agent_task; create_entity makes a row but doesn't dispatch.

fixtures.prompt: Has milestone ms-xyz actually finished — are all child tasks done?
fixtures.rationale: verify_entity_completion is the explicit child-rollup check.

fixtures.prompt: Add 5 tasks to the deploy milestone with dependencies between them.
fixtures.rationale: Multiple entities with refs is batch_create_entities; description warns about looping create_entity.

fixtures.prompt: Pause the 4 marketing tasks while we decide on the new positioning.
fixtures.rationale: Bulk lifecycle action is batch_action; entity_action handles one at a time.

fixtures.prompt: Spin up the migration project and start the agents now.
fixtures.rationale: scaffold_initiative auto-launches by default; spawn_agent_task is one-off.

fixtures.prompt: Show me all the comments on task t-xyz.
fixtures.rationale: Comment threads have their own list endpoint.

fixtures.prompt: Are the streams for initiative i-abc healthy and progressing?
fixtures.rationale: Stream-level state is dedicated; pulse is initiative-level rollup.

fixtures.prompt: What should the agent do next on the platform initiative?
fixtures.rationale: Recommendation has its own surface; pulse is read-only health.

fixtures.prompt: How does scaffold_initiative work — what fields does it accept?
fixtures.rationale: Self-describe lookup is the right path; calling the tool would actually scaffold.

fixtures.prompt: Change the priority of task t-abc to high.
fixtures.rationale: Generic field patch is update_entity; entity_action is for lifecycle/special actions.
